sources.note: CGM eMDs product page / mandatory disclosures. Describes core modules: Chart, CGM PRESCRIBE, scheduling, PM/billing, patient portal, CGM MEASURES, DocMan, TaskMan. Lists EHI export documentation, FHIR API docs, and Real World Testing plans.

CGM US homepage. Lists full US product portfolio: multiple EHR products (APRIMA, eMDs, CLINICAL, ENTERPRISE, PLUS, PRACTICE PARTNER), lab systems (LABDAQ, MEDICUS, SCHUYLAB), billing/RCM (ARIA), telehealth (ELVI), AI (AMBI).
Explains eMDs rebranding to CompuGroup Medical after acquisition. Notes the company history from 1996 founding by Dr. David Winn.
Acquisition completion announcement (Dec 31, 2020). eMDs had ~EUR 81M revenue, 1,400+ employees, 60,000+ providers in 32,000+ facilities, ~100 sales partners.
Initial acquisition announcement (Nov 2020). USD 240M purchase price. Describes CGM becoming top-4 US ambulatory IT provider.
PR Newswire version of acquisition announcement with additional financial details.
eMDs acquires Aprima (Jan 2019). Combined entity: 63,000+ providers in 26,000+ practices.
eMDs acquires McKesson ambulatory assets (Medisoft, Lytec, Practice Partner, Practice Choice) in April 2016.
Wikipedia article on CGM. Company history, global operations, ownership structure (Gotthardt family ~50%, CVC Capital Partners ~28%), 2025 delisting.

Capterra reviews for CGM eMDs. Overall 2.2/5 across 46 reviews. Pros: ease of use, customizable templates, fast learning curve. Cons: hidden costs, slow support, reliability issues with updates, unexpected billing.
Software Advice profile for CGM eMDs with reviews and pricing information.
GetApp feature list and reviews for CGM eMDs Solution Series.
FindEMR profile for e-MDs with feature descriptions and user reviews.
KLAS Research vendor profile for CompuGroup Medical US. ARIA RCM Services won Best in KLAS for ambulatory RCM 2023-2025.
HIT Consultant coverage of CGM-eMDs acquisition for $240M.
eMEDIX clearinghouse product page. Real-time eligibility, ERA posting, claims edits/scrubbing, claim status automation, denial management.
CGM patient portal page. Describes bilingual portal with health record access, appointment requests, secure messaging, intake forms, surveys.
CGM US About page. Company overview, mission ('Synchronizing Healthcare'), global stats.
Marlin Equity Partners acquires e-MDs (March 2015). Beginning of consolidation phase.
Marlin/e-MDs acquire McKesson ambulatory assets. Details on Medisoft, Lytec, Practice Partner product lines.
